title: TeamVocabulary
description: What the team generator may draw from, exported from the pinned engine for one format (ADR-013 section 2): the roster the validator accepts, each roster species' abilities and move pool as the validator judges them, the natures, the items the format does not ban, and the rule-table values (adjustLevel, evLimit, item clause, team sizes). It reuses the engine-data export (ADR-010 section 3), which it names by hash, and adds what that table leaves out. Every list is sorted by id; sorted and unique ids and agreement with an engine-data table are enforced by the reader (the contract profile has no uniqueItems or cross references). Its RFC 8785 SHA-256 is the vocabulary hash. No game rule is written by hand: every value is read from the pinned engine.

showdown_commit.description: The pinned engine commit the vocabulary was exported from.

mod.description: The engine data mod the format plays on.

engine_data_hash.description: The engine-data hash (ADR-010 section 3) of the table for the same commit and format: ids here are ids of that table.

natures.description: Natures the validator accepts, sorted by id.

items.description: Item ids the format does not ban, sorted and unique.

roster.description: Species the validator accepts, sorted by id.

RuleValues.description: The format's rule-table values, read from the engine's resolved rule table.

adjust_level.description: adjustLevel: every team member is set to this level.

ev_limit.description: evLimit: the total Stat Points (EVs) a set may hold.

item_clause.description: The Item Clause's value: how many members may hold the same item.

min_team_size.description: The fewest members a team may have.

max_team_size.description: The most members a team may have.

picked_team_size.description: How many members are brought to a battle after Team Preview.

Nature.description: A nature as the engine lists it; plus and minus are a stat id, or empty for a neutral nature.

RosterEntry.description: One species the validator accepts, with the abilities and moves it accepts on it. required_item is present for a forme that needs a held item (a Mega forme).

id.description: The species id, as in the engine-data table.

abilities.description: Ability ids the validator accepts on this species, sorted and unique.

moves.description: Move ids the validator accepts on this species, sorted and unique: the move pool.

required_item.description: The item the forme must hold.
